instruction: List Consul WAN operator areas
output:
consul operator area list
Area ID                               Name                  Peers
12345678-abcd-ef01-2345-6789abcdef01  dc1-dc2              2
23456789-bcde-f012-3456-789abcdef012  dc1-dc3              1

instruction: Join a Consul WAN operator area
output:
consul operator area join -dc=dc2 10.0.2.1:8302
Address 10.0.2.1:8302 added to area. Joined 1 servers via WAN gossip

instruction: Create a new Consul WAN operator area
output:
consul operator area create -peer-datacenter=dc4 -retry-join=10.0.4.1:8302
Area created with ID: 34567890-cdef-0123-4567-890abcdef012

instruction: Get detailed info about a Consul WAN area
output:
consul operator area info 12345678-abcd-ef01-2345-6789abcdef01
Area ID:    12345678-abcd-ef01-2345-6789abcdef01
Name:       dc1-dc2
Peer with:  dc2
Member info:
  10.0.2.1:8302  alive  server  dc2
  10.0.2.2:8302  alive  server  dc2
